richProcedureText: Charge salicylic acid (100 g) to the reactor under nitrogen. Heat the mixture to 80 °C and stir for 2 h at atmospheric pressure. The reaction was quenched with water. The product was extracted with toluene. The solid was isolated by filtration and dried under vacuum. Yield of crude product was obtained after crystallization.
